task.title: Choose a Firefox schema channel
task.shortdesc: Choose Firefox Release 153, Firefox ESR 153.0, Firefox ESR 140.13, or Firefox ESR 115.38 before importing, validating, or editing a profile.

prereq.p: Start this task before creating a profile, importing policies.json, or validating a raw JSON document.

context.p: The schema channel decides which Firefox policies BPM can validate and which controls are shown as supported. Release 153 and ESR 153.0 include current policy controls such as AIControls and VisualSearchEnabled; ESR 140.13 remains a separately supported long-support channel. ESR 115.38 is separately supported for limited legacy-operating-system critical-security needs, not as an extension of operating-system vendor support; recheck that support boundary on 2027-03-01. BPM does not migrate profiles automatically between supported ESR channels.

step.cmd: Compare the target browser fleet with the supported channels: Release 153, ESR 153.0, ESR 140.13, and ESR 115.38.

info.p: Expected result: the selected schema channel remains visible and intentional.

step.cmd: Choose ESR 115.38, ESR 140.13, or ESR 153.0 for the matching supported Extended Support Release deployment.

info.p: Expected result: the selected schema channel remains visible and intentional.

step.cmd: Choose Release 153 or ESR 153.0 when the profile needs current controls, including supported AI and visual search policies.

info.p: Expected result: the selected schema channel remains visible and intentional.

step.cmd: Validate after choosing the channel and before saving, export, or handoff.

info.note: Validation can change from valid to invalid when the schema channel changes. Confirm the channel before saving or exporting.

result.p: The profile uses the schema channel that matches the intended Firefox deployment.

postreq.p: Recovery: if validation reports unsupported, unavailable, deprecated, or unknown settings, confirm the schema channel before editing policy values. Any move between distinct current artifacts, including ESR 115.38, ESR 140.13, ESR 153.0, and Release 153, requires an explicit target-channel decision, a fresh preview, and review. A blocked, stale, invalid, or failed conversion leaves the saved profile unchanged.
